name: fly_locator_tiny_s2_v5
architecture: dl_tracking.model VARIANTS['tiny_s2'], 2.05 M MACs per canvas
training: dl_tracking.train, run tiny_s2_v5 (best epoch 23), dense 3x3 offsets, human labels from review rounds 1-3

presence.meaning: logit that the canvas holds a fly

preprocessing.downsample: cv2.resize INTER_AREA to half resolution, once per frame
preprocessing.canvas_origin: centred on the ROI rectangle, half-resolution pixels

movement: xy_dist_log10x1000 = round(1000 * log10((1 + step) / max(crop width, crop height))), as AdaptiveBGModel; step is the frame-to-frame displacement in px after the cross-tube shake correction
